author: Emily Mae  Czachor
title: FDA warns Novo Nordisk over unreported potential Ozempic side effects
description: The FDA issued a warning letter to Novo Nordisk, the Danish drugmaker behind the diabetes and weight-loss medications Ozempic and Wegovy, over unreported potential side effects.
content: Novo Nordisk, the pharmaceutical company behind Ozempic, has received a warning letter from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration over issues with its procedures for reporting potential side effects … [+2248 chars]
